notes_for_editor: Thin record. No source gives a build year, builder, height, or removal date, so the story gives none. The steel replacement's date is not given either. No source describes what remains on the site or whether it is open to visitors; record access stays 'unknown'. A Mon Forest Towns guide lists a former fire tower site along the middle of the North Fork Mountain Trail but does not name it, so it is not linked here. Pike Knob (FFLA: US 1587, WV 21) is a separate record and was not merged. The record marks the two National Archives photos 'All rights reserved'; federal photos are often public domain, so check the licence before reuse.
